road.title: Hello and goodbye
road.description: A broad figure built like a cupboard in a cloak patched with pieces of other cloaks, holding a clipboard like a shield. Sidonie is a Census Taker and has been counting the people on this road since before it was a road and is missing exactly one.

openObjectives.prompt: Sidonie is plainly waiting to be greeted and will not be the one to start. Greet Sidonie, using Italian.
Sidonie is holding a list and a pencil, and you are not on the list. Tell Sidonie your name, using Italian.
Sidonie has asked how you are and, unusually, wants to know. Tell Sidonie how you are, using Italian.

character.name: Sidonie Parsnip
character.description: A broad figure built like a cupboard in a cloak patched with pieces of other cloaks, holding a clipboard like a shield. Sidonie is a Census Taker and has been counting the people on this road since before it was a road and is missing exactly one.

npc.narrative: You enter the recinto, under a grey cielo. Sidonie Parsnip sits at a tavolo with una carta, a sharp matita and una fila of exactly one. It is notte, and she counts you piano, twice, with ancora more pazienza.
npc.native: Buonasera! Salve! Sono Sidonie, e conto le persone. Tu non saluti?
npc.translation: Good evening! Hello! I am Sidonie, and I count people. Aren't you saying hello?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely start! You greeted Sidonie warmly in Italian, and she will be glad to hear a little more from you next.

objectiveResults.feedback: You greeted Sidonie in Italian with "Ciao" and "Buonasera", well done.
You didn't tell Sidonie your name yet; she would like to know it, so this will come up again.
You didn't say how you are yet; Sidonie would like to hear it, so this will be asked again later.

openObjectives.prompt: Sidonie is holding a list and a pencil, and you are not on the list. Tell Sidonie your name, using Italian.
Sidonie has asked how you are and, unusually, wants to know. Tell Sidonie how you are, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Sidonie ticks a small box on her modulo and looks at you over the penna. The strada is empty and the alba is chiara, but she has formed a fila anyway, with one person in it. You are standing slightly in front of it.
npc.native: Ecco, un saluto! Mi chiamo Sidonie Parsnip. Come ti chiami?
npc.translation: There, a greeting! My name is Sidonie Parsnip. What is your name?

player: Mi chiamo Marco. E... come stai?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely start, Marco! You gave your name in clear Italian and even asked Sidonie how she is.

objectiveResults.feedback: You told Sidonie your name correctly with "Mi chiamo Marco".
You asked Sidonie how she is, which is nice, but this one needs you to say how you are. Sidonie will give you another chance to do that.

openObjectives.prompt: Sidonie has asked how you are and, unusually, wants to know. Tell Sidonie how you are, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Sidonie writes your nome on a modulo, with a matita so sharp it has opinions. The alba is clear, e la strada behind you is già counted. Beside her she leaves a pausa, for a successore who has not arrived.
npc.native: Piacere, Marco! Io sto bene, grazie. E tu, come stai?
npc.translation: Pleased to meet you, Marco! I am fine, thank you. And you, how are you?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely answer, Marco! You told Sidonie how you are in correct Italian and added a polite "grazie".

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done: "Sto bene" is correct Italian for telling Sidonie how you are.

npc.narrative: Il sole rises sopra la strada, and il cielo is perfectly clear. Sidonie writes your name on a long modulo with una piccola penna, then ticks a box. Behind you, una fila of nobody waits.
npc.native: Perfetto, Marco! Siamo tutti e due bene. Scrivo il tuo nome sul modulo. Va bene?
npc.translation: Perfect, Marco! We are both well. I write your name on the form. Is that all right?

npc.narrative: Sidonie writes your nome on the modulo, piano, with a very old penna. The alba is clear and the strada is empty, yet she leaves a pausa at the end of the line, as if someone were meant to fill it. Nobody does, ma she seems used to it.
npc.native: Prego, Marco! Il modulo è pronto. Manca una persona, ma tu sei qui. Stai bene stamattina?
npc.translation: You're welcome, Marco! The form is ready. One person is missing, but you are here. Are you well this morning?

npc.narrative: The alba is clear over the strada, and Sidonie's penna stops halfway down the modulo. She leaves a pausa for the successor, poi looks at you over the form, molto exact. Behind you a fila of one has formed, ma nobody is in it yet.
npc.native: Bene, bene! Ma il modulo non è finito, Marco. Aspetti un momento?
npc.translation: Good, good! But the form is not finished, Marco. Will you wait a moment?
